meta.name: dream-video-prompt-generator
meta.description: 电商运营与内容创作者在制作数字人带货短视频时，用本技能一键生成即梦视频中英文提示词。依托四大智能体协同与专属公式，确保人物与情绪高度一致，完美适配5s带货场景，高效产出高质量分镜脚本，让视频制作事半功倍！

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入带货主题，生成数字人短视频的中英文分镜提示词
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你是电商运营或内容创作者，常做数字人带货短视频却苦于写提示词。
copy.tagline_en: Turn product info into bilingual video prompts for digital-human selling clips.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create digital-human selling videos and struggle with prompt writing.

howto.what: 你提出数字人带货视频需求后,它按公式(主体+运动+场景+镜头语言+光影+氛围)逐幕输出即梦提示词,中英文双版,默认5幕每幕5秒;并附带对应的Suno音乐提示词和AI绘画提示词。
howto.when: 当你需要生成小省导购员数字人带货视频的提示词时接管;场景类型如产品推荐、价格对比、促销活动等,情绪基调与分镜幕次由你提供。

say.text: 帮我生成一条产品推荐带货视频的5幕即梦提示词,情绪热情专业。
say.note: 会先核查知识库,再输出中英文逐幕提示词。

say.text: 把价格对比视频的提示词改成3幕,每幕5s。
say.note: 按公式重新生成,并做一致性核查。

say.text: 再给我这套分镜对应的Suno音乐和AI绘画提示词。
say.note: 输出与即梦提示词同源的音乐和绘画提示词。

howto.what_en: After you describe a digital-human sales video, it outputs Jimeng prompts by formula (subject+movement+scene+shot language+light+atmosphere), in Chinese and English, default 5 scenes of 5s each, plus Suno music and AI painting prompts.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you need Jimeng prompts for a Xiaosheng digital-human sales video, e.g. product recommendation, price comparison or promotion scenes; emotion tone and scene count come from you.

say_en.text: Generate 5-scene Jimeng prompts for a product video, warm professional tone.
say_en.note: Checks knowledge base first, outputs bilingual scene prompts.

say_en.text: Change the price-comparison prompts to 3 scenes, 5s each.
say_en.note: Regenerates by formula and runs a consistency check.

say_en.text: Also give me the matching Suno music and AI painting prompts.
say_en.note: Outputs same-source music and painting prompts.
